Curated Repertoire

The Turin Chapters

Chapter 01 · Historic Salons

The Grand Cafés
& Conspirators

2.5 Hours • Includes Bicerin or Vermouth • €42

In 19th-century Turin, revolutions and kingdoms were not born in parliament—they were plotted over marble tables under crystal chandeliers.

We take you inside the gilded sanctuaries where Cavour, Nietzsche, and royal spies gathered. Taste the original 1763 Bicerin (hot espresso, dark cocoa, whipped cream), discover the secret wartime arsenal hidden beneath the floors of Baratti & Milano, and understand why the city invented Vermouth in 1786.

Chapter 02 · Royal Architecture

Royal Scandals
& Hidden Courtyards

2h 15m • Monumental Walk • €28

Behind the severe brick facades of the House of Savoy lies one of Europe’s most daring baroque landscapes and juiciest court gossip.

We bypass the textbook recitations to explore the curved masterwork of Palazzo Carignano, secret courtyards of the Palazzo Reale, and the glass-domed Galleria Subalpina. Learn about the secret staircases of King Vittorio Emanuele II and the architecture of power designed by Guarino Guarini and Filippo Juvarra.

Chapter 03 · Local Dialect & Lore

The Art of
Piedmontese Swearing

2.0 Hours • Includes Wine in Historic Piòla • €26

Based on the beloved regional book Insultario Piamontés. Standard Italian is for diplomacy; Piedmontese is for the unfiltered soul.

Walk through the ancient Quadrilatero Romano and the colorful market alleys of Porta Palazzo to decode why the people of Turin are proudly called Bogianen ("we don't budge"). An anthropological, hilarious, and affectionate journey into regional wit, concluding with a traditional gotto of wine in a neighborhood tavern.
